decision.hypothesis: Same demand hypothesis as its pair Mosaic, but delivered as a page on a regional authority domain. Tests whether shared site-level authority and internal linking outrank a dedicated hyperlocal domain — or whether exact-match hyperlocal focus wins.
decision.successCondition: >=100 impressions/month on community-modified queries within 6 months, OR >=1 qualified lead. Architecture comparison is judged on WITHIN-PAIR difference in time-to-first-impression, time-to-top-20 and impressions at 6 months.
decision.failureCondition: indexed but <20 impressions/month after 6 months across ALL community-modified queries while city controls perform in line with measured volume — falsifies hyper-local under-measurement. Architecture verdict is void if fewer than 4 of 6 pairs produce interpretable data.

build.domainStatus: verified-available-at-freeze — RE-CHECK AND PURCHASE BEFORE BUILD
build.contentDirective: Identical specification across BOTH treatments: same visual quality, conversion architecture, topical coverage, schema, publishing window, indexing workflow and tracking. Only the architecture differs.
internalLinking: Home links to every service page and the top service areas
Each service page links to its Service × Area variants
Area pages cross-link to sibling areas to distribute authority
Every commercial page links back to a single conversion path
cannibalizationGuidance: Point the home page at "Pool Builder Union Park" and make the head service page a supporting overview, or drop the separate service page entirely.
Planned page count materially exceeds the number of distinct search intents — build the intents that exist rather than filling a template.
localSignalsMissing: verified landmarks / climate / local regulation / local pricing evidence (not collected — must not be fabricated at build time)
build.doNotFabricate: Local facts (landmarks, climate, regulations, pricing) were NOT collected. Build pages only from evidence in this spec or verified at build time — never invent local claims.

localPack.note: map pack inherited from the parent city; Google renders no distinct community pack, so this asset must win ORGANIC

economics.note: ALL HUMAN_ASSUMED until live data replaces them. Never present these as measured.
economics.recommendedMonetizationModel: per-lead (long sales cycle makes flat rent hard to justify before the renter sees ROI)
economics.volumeState: provider-reports-zero — THE HYPOTHESIS UNDER TEST, not a validated demand figure

outcomeContract.rankingCadence: weekly from publishDate through week 12, then fortnightly through week 26

queriesToTrack.primary: 1 — the exact service+geography query the asset targets
queriesToTrack.communityModified: community assets only: community-name and service+community queries
queriesToTrack.unpredicted: any query Search Console reports impressions for that no keyword tool predicted — the direct test of hyper-local under-measurement

outcomeContract.nullRule: UNKNOWN is never zero. Do not post a metric you did not measure; for a rank check where the site is absent from the top 100, post position 'notFound' — never 101 or 0.
